name: Ordinary modern Turkish

loanwords.context_rule: No Arabic lemma has a mandatory one-to-one Turkish replacement; local sense and grammar control wording.

editorial_tests: An ordinary Turkish reader can understand the sentence without specialist religious vocabulary.
Replacing or retaining a loanword does not narrow or expand the Arabic improperly.
The wording states the ordinary proposition without commentary or latent activation.
Speaker, addressee, agency, negation, and direction remain explicit where Arabic makes them explicit.
